column5: Anthropic's OFFICIAL Linux build (Chat + Cowork + Claude Code), in beta since 2026-06-30. Official support is Debian/Ubuntu ONLY, via Anthropic's apt repo - the docs tell Arch and Fedora users to run the CLI instead. So this AUR package is the path: it downloads the official .deb from downloads.claude.ai and repackages its payload, plus symlink shims for the Debian paths Cowork hardcodes (virtiofsd, OVMF). Not a third-party rebuild. The qemu-system-x86 + edk2-ovmf + virtiofsd deps are Cowork's VM sandbox and are parity with the .deb's Recommends, which apt installs by default - NOT AUR bloat. See SETUP-GUIDE Phase 5 for the KVM prerequisites, and Phase 4 for the memory tension with the Docker Desktop argument
